description: This file defines a Leaflet map control for toggling fullscreen mode, including handling native FullScreen API support and integrating with Leaflet map lifecycle.

classes.name: L.Control.FullScreen
classes.description: A Leaflet control for toggling fullscreen mode, managing fullscreen API support, and updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: onAdd
methods.description: Called when the control is added to the map; creates the fullscreen toggle button and sets up event listeners.

methods.name: onRemove
methods.description: Called when the control is removed from the map; removes event listeners.

methods.name: _createButton
methods.description: Creates the fullscreen toggle button element and attaches event handlers.

methods.name: toggleFullScreen
methods.description: Toggles the map between fullscreen and windowed mode, using the FullScreen API if supported.

methods.name: _toggleTitle
methods.description: Updates the button title based on fullscreen state.

methods.name: _handleFullscreenChange
methods.description: Handles changes in fullscreen state, updating the map and firing events.
